subject: maths

items.why: Pythagoras needs a right angle; c is the hypotenuse, the longest side opposite it.

items.q: What do sin, cos and tan give you?
items.correct: Ratios of sides — use inverse functions to find an angle.
items.why: tan = opp/adj, sin = opp/hyp, cos = adj/hyp; sin⁻¹ etc. give the angle.
